value: Giantess growth simulation game with pixelart graphics.

You wake up stranded on an island with a girl named Mia. 
A mural in the center of the island depicts a ring which shows some type of giant woman figure.

Explore an island and speak with Mia to play minigames to increase the experience meter. 
Whenever the meter is full Mia grows a size larger, making subsequent minigames harder.
